title: Out of Province Scholarships Scheme
description: BEEF has launched a new “ Out of Province Scholarships Scheme for Local/ Domiciled Students of Balochistan studying outside Balochistan in the Public Sector educational institutions of Punjab, Sindh, KPK, AJK, Gilgit Baltistan and Islamabad capital territory. Under this scheme scholarships are awarded on merits to the students of Balochistan for financial facilitation in the following Sessions/Academic years of BS Professional Programs (4 & 5 Years) Masters & MS/MPhil Degree Programs.
eligibilityCriteria: Local/Domiciled students of Balochistan enrolled in Pakistan based Public Sector Institutions situated outside
Having Secured at least 60% marks or 3GPA/CGPA and that name of students is included in the merit list provided to BEEF by concerned
Students availing any other scholarships are not eligible to apply.
Students enrolled in BS, Masters & MS/MPhil must apply through the Focal Person/Financial Aid Office (FAO) or any other designated office of the concerned institution.
No individual Scholarship Application Form will be accepted and students of private institutions are not eligible.
Copy of Required Transcript/Annual Result
Copy of student CNIC or B-Form or CNIC of

description: BS (4/5 Years) Professional Degree Programs (MBBS, BDS, BEMS, LLB, DPT & others.

Must have secured at least 60% Marks in previous year Annual Exam or 03 GPA/CGPA.

Students availing other scholarships are not eligible to apply.

the eligibility for BEEF scholarships is at least 60% marks and 45% marks for Special Quota.

title: PEEF Scholarship for Balochistan
description: The Punjab Educational Endowment Fund (PEEF) under the umbrella of Balochistan Education Endowment Fund (BEEF) allocates around 460 slots of scholarships each year for the deserving students of Balochistan. The scheme covers Intermediate (FA/FSc/DAE) & equivalent, Gradation (ADA, ADS/BS Professional), Master and MS/MPhil levels of education as per given detail:

title: Shaheed Benazir Bhutto Scholarships For Transgenders
description: The CM Scholarship is a golden opportunity for transgender individuals in Balochistan. It provides much-needed financial support to help them pursue higher education both domestically and internationally. This scholarship opens doors to schools, colleges, and universities, empowering transgender people to reach their full potential and transform their lives. It is a significant achievement for the transgender community in Balochistan, who have fought tirelessly for their rights, and now have the government's support to pursue their education.
eligibilityCriteria: Must have local/domicile of Balochistan
Must have obtained certificate from proper authority regarding authentication of being transgender and authentication from current educational institution.
Must be enrolled in any class level from Kindergarten/Nursery till BS.
Actual Institutional Tuition Fee
Stipend to cover travel, books, and uniform.

title: Chief Minister Merit Foreign Scholarship for Ph.D Program – (CMSPP)
description: Are you a bright and motivated student from Balochistan, ready to undertake a PhD in a top 100 QS ranking university ? The Chief Minister - Merit Scholarships for Leading PhD Programs (CMSPP) are your gateway to international academic excellence! In STEM Subject 70% and Social Sciences, Humanities, or Arts (30%).
eligibilityCriteria: Comprehensive Support : Fully funded scholarships covering tuition fees, living allowances, health insurance, airfare, and visa processing fees. (Upper Ceilings Fixed)
Elite Institutions : Study in world-renowned universities ranked within the top 100 QS rankings.
Diverse Fields : Pursue your PhD in STEM subjects(70%), Social Sciences, Humanities, or Arts(30%).
Transformative Impact : Become part of a critical mass of highly qualified professionals driving the socio-economic development of Balochistan.
Maximum age of 40 (forty) years as at the closing date of the advertisement.
Resident of Balochistan having local and domicile of the Province, having permanent and present address of Balochistan in CNIC. Residence certificate from district administration is also required.
Not less than 60% marks throughout the academic career (Only one second division allowed in career other than MS/MPhil).

title: Shaheed Benazir Bhutto Fully Funded Scholarships for District Toppers of Matric Students of Balochistan
description: After a briefing by CEO BEEF , the Honorable Chief Minister of Balochistan appreciated BEEF efforts and further taken visionary initiative to boost healthy competition and reward hardworking students of Balochistan through awarding Fully Funded Annual Scholarships for the District Toppers (top-10 ) (Female 5 and male 5) for Matric Students of Balochistan under Shaheed Benazir Bhutto Fully Funded flag-ship Scholarships program for quality education. It shall be managed by Balochistan Education Endowment Fund (BEEF).
eligibilityCriteria: 10 toppers of each district have passed out Matriculation from Government Institutions of Balochistan, the Annual Examination conducted and result 2025 declared by the Balochistan Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education (BBISE) or Federal Board of Intermediate and Examination (FBISE).
Aspirant students must have studied from Balochistan based institutions.
2 years Intermediate or equivalent on the basis of result 2025 of Matriculation annual exams declared by BBISE/FBISE.
Must have local/domicile of Balochistan.
Must have present & permanent address of Balochistan in CNIC.

Must have passed exam from Government Institutions of Balochistan and exam taken by Balochistan Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education (BBISE) or Federal Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education (FBISE).
Must have secured at-least 60% marks and have attained position amongst top 10 in their respective district.

title: Shaheed Benazir Bhutto Fully Funded scholarships program for Civil Martyrs of Balochistan
description: Scholarships for the children of declared martyrs of civil martyrs of Balochistan by the Chief Minister of Balochistan reflects a significant step towards supporting the families of those who have sacrificed their lives in the region's turbulent history. Balochistan, the largest province of Pakistan, has faced various challenges, including economic disparities, political instability, and a prolonged insurgency.
eligibilityCriteria: For the Children of Martyrs of Civil Armed Forces and Government Employees of Balochistan
Must have local/domicile of Balochistan.
The Martyred parent should have been employed by Government of Balochistan.
Child must be enrolled in any class level from Kindergarten/Nursery till 16 years of education in any institution located within Pakistan.

title: HCM Martyrs Memorial Fully Funded Scholarship Program- SPS
description: The Chief Minister’s Martyrs Memorial Fully Funded Scholarship Program is a landmark initiative launched by the Government of Balochistan under the visionary leadership of Honorable Chief Minister Mir Sarfraz Ahmed Bugti. The program aims to provide world-class education to academically talented but underprivileged students from Balochistan, especially those from the province’s most remote and underserved districts.
eligibilityCriteria: Full tuition fee from the date of admission until completion of schooling (Matric/O Levels & beyond, subject to academic performance).
Books, notebooks, stationery, and educational resources provided by the school.
Boarding facilities in SPS hostels with comfortable living arrangements.
Full meals (breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks) as per SPS dining standards.
Laundry and personal hygiene facilities.
Debates, Dramatics, and Declamations
Sports: Football, cricket, basketball, tennis, hockey, and more.
